resources.string: Stop Facebook photos from flooding Google Photos

On Xiaomi devices, Facebook saves photos and videos into DCIM/Facebook, which is inside your camera roll. Google Photos treats that folder as part of your camera roll and backs everything up.
This app watches that folder in the background and moves anything new into a separate Facebook_Saved folder, deleting the original from DCIM/Facebook so Google Photos never picks it up.
To do this it needs \"All files access\" — without it, Android blocks apps from deleting files they didn\'t create themselves, which is the \"permission denied\" error you may have hit before.
✅ All files access granted. Background job is scheduled and will run every 15 minutes.
⚠️ All files access not granted yet. The background job cannot move or delete files without it.
Disable Battery Optimization For This App

Xiaomi\'s MIUI/HyperOS aggressively kills background apps even when a permission is granted. For the background job to survive, also do this once:
1. Security app → App Battery Saver → find this app → set to \"No restrictions\". 2. Security app → Permissions → Autostart → enable Autostart for this app. 3. Recent apps screen → swipe this app\'s card down (or tap the lock icon) to lock it so MIUI doesn\'t sweep it away.
The button below opens the Security app\'s permissions screen where most of this lives; the exact menu wording varies by MIUI version.
